name: sentiment-reproducibility
research_question: How far does a pure-Python text classifier move under controlled perturbations of the corpus version, the feature space, the learning rate and the software environment - relative to how far it moves when only the random seed changes?

checks.name: code
checks.detail: logistic-regression at sha256:822ca4c09cfa4cd0, commit 2078734d7f4b with uncommitted changes: the entrypoint file is pinned but the modules it imports are not

checks.name: seeds
checks.detail: 10/10 seeds completed in the thinnest arm

checks.name: statistics
checks.detail: 4/4 comparisons tested, holm-corrected at alpha=0.05, analysis version 1.0

checks.name: artifacts
checks.detail: 83 artifacts, all present and matching their digests

checks.name: provenance
checks.detail: 83 runs recorded (0 failed); every successful run carries its environment, hardware and code identity

checks.name: determinism
checks.detail: Deterministic: 4 executions of an identical run produced identical values on every result metric (accuracy, f1, vocabulary_size). train_seconds varied, as expected: those measure the machine rather than the method.

checks.name: reproducibility
checks.detail: Across 6 perturbation axes, the most fragile is 'dataset' (stability 0.00); the geometric mean is 0.02. Changing configuration, dataset moves accuracy beyond the tolerance declared for it, so a reproduction differing on those axes should not be expected to match. On implementation the data cannot decide whether the shift stays within tolerance; more runs would be needed to say.

notes: A verdict of PASS WITH GAPS means every check that could be run passed, and some could not be run. The gaps are listed above; they are not failures, but they are not verification either.
